CryptoJS 4.2.0 (MIT), bundled with esbuild 0.25.12. Used only to decode the sites' existing AES-CBC/PBKDF2 and SHA-256 formats, not to implement a new encryption protocol. Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/crypto-js/v/4.2.0 . Entrypoint: module.exports = require("crypto-js"); esbuild --bundle --format=iife --global-name=CryptoJS --platform=browser --external:crypto --minify. Native crypto is optional and is never needed for decryption or hashing here. No Node or npm dependency is required at scraper runtime.
